content.short: Land registration dApp using Cardano NFTs and the Open Cadastral Map.
content.description: Landano is a solution to the data quality problem in land administration. It provides reliable, open data to support land management in an easy-to-query, mobile-friendly interface supported by maps, permanent archival records, and blockchain integrity checks. Producing trustworthy records of land ownership can be a stepping stone for many marginalized people into more advanced financial services such as mortgages, crop loans, subletting, and a growing number of DeFi opportunities.
